verdict.rationale: The docs include copy-paste TypeScript/JS snippets for the core metering calls (`autumn.check`, `autumn.track`), a getting-started setup with `atmn pull`, and documented billing endpoints for the payment side: attach for subscriptions and upgrades, preview attach, and the customer portal. That suggests a docs-driven integration path is plausible, but there is no copy-paste code for the payment/attach flow itself and no evidence of examples in languages other than JS/TS. Nothing corroborates that a developer can get a working payment flow done in under a day. Missing for 10: copy-paste attach/checkout examples, multi-language SDK snippets, hands-on reports of time-to-integrate, an accessible OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
